text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just taking a picture, a computer can analyze it to recognize faces, identify objects, and even read text. For example, object detection helps a system find a dog, a car, or a tree in a photo, labeling each one with a box. This technology is everywhere: social media uses it to tag people, and security cameras use it to spot unusual activity. One of the most exciting applications is in self-driving cars. These vehicles use cameras and computer vision to detect pedestrians, traffic lights, and other vehicles, making split-second decisions to drive safely. As this field improves, it will change how we interact with technology in our daily lives.
